title: Taskelith review finding
description: One line of an OpenSpec change's findings.jsonl: one finding of an independent review pass. Reviewer text is untrusted, so every string is bounded, control characters are rejected, and unknown properties are rejected. The category vocabulary is docs/review-findings/categories.txt, which npm run findings checks; this schema checks only the category's form.

change.description: Name of the OpenSpec change, without the archive date prefix.

artifact.description: The artifact that a multi-artifact change reviews, each with its own reviewers and passes; omitted when the change reviews one artifact.

pass.description: Number of the review pass of the finding's artifact, counted as the review process counts passes; failed attempts are not passes.

harness.description: Reviewer harness, for example codex, opencode, claude, or antigravity.

model.description: Model id as set in the invocation, for example gpt-6.1-sol.

variant.description: Variant or reasoning effort as set in the invocation, for example medium or high.

session.description: Session or conversation id that the reviewer reported for the pass.

severity.description: Severity as the review process names it.

title.description: One-line summary of the finding, written by the author, not pasted reviewer output.

file.description: Repository-relative path of the file the finding concerns.

line.description: Line of the file the finding concerns, when it has one.

capability.description: Name of the OpenSpec capability (spec) the finding concerns. npm run findings requires an existing one under openspec/specs for a finding of an active change whose file is outside openspec/changes/; a change that skips specs names the closest capability. In an active change any named capability must exist.

outcome.description: fixed and checked by a later pass; fixed-unreviewed; declined with a reason; deferred to later work; owner-accepted as a known risk.

resolution.description: Short description of the resolution or the reason it was declined or deferred.

commit.description: Abbreviated or full SHA of the commit that resolved the finding, when there is one.

missedBy.description: What missed the finding before it was found: an earlier pass of this change and of the finding's artifact, with that pass's role, which npm run findings checks against the pass's summary in passes.jsonl, or "integration" for work already integrated into dev.

role.description: Reviewer role of the review process, A or B; under policy version 5 reviewer A makes passes 1 and 3 and reviewer B pass 2.

identifier.description: Lowercase letters, digits, and inner hyphens, starting with a letter.

text.description: One line of text without C0 or C1 control characters, DEL, or Unicode line and paragraph separators.
